title: SKILL FIRST · GUARD RECOVERY FLOW
emphasis: Continue yesterday’s guard-angle plan at the same technical stage. Use one uninterrupted recovery-to-angle flow so the sequence can settle into rhythm; no speed progression is assumed.

ignition.name: Moving Guard-Recovery Prep
ignition.prescription: Move continuously: 90 sec easy bridges and hip turns, 90 sec hip escapes back to a seated base, then 2 min sticky-foot pummeling into butterfly-half position. Demo unavailable.
ignition.home: Move continuously: 90 sec easy bridges and hip turns, 90 sec hip escapes back to a seated base, then 2 min sticky-foot pummeling into butterfly-half position. Demo unavailable.
ignition.away: Use the same unloaded sequence on a mat and keep every range comfortable.
ignition.cue: Recover your base before reaching for the angle.

deposits.label: A
deposits.title: SKILL · RECOVER TO THE ANGLE
deposits.effort: One uninterrupted 8-min technical block. No rep target; reset naturally whenever position quality slips.

exercises.name: Guard Recovery → Butterfly Half → Arm-Drag Angle
exercises.prescription: Flow safely with a grappling dummy: recover your seated base, establish sticky feet, enter butterfly half, create the arm-drag angle, settle, then reset naturally. Keep it unresisted and pause whenever connection or balance breaks. Demo unavailable.
exercises.home: Flow safely with a grappling dummy: recover your seated base, establish sticky feet, enter butterfly half, create the arm-drag angle, settle, then reset naturally. Keep it unresisted and pause whenever connection or balance breaks. Demo unavailable.
exercises.away: Shadow the complete sequence continuously on a mat, using natural resets rather than rushed repetitions.
exercises.cue: Base first, sticky feet second, arm-drag angle last.

deposits.label: B
deposits.title: SUPPORT · PULL, ROTATE, STAY STACKED
deposits.effort: Light-to-moderate quality work. Keep 2–3 clean reps in reserve; no load progression is prescribed.

exercises.name: One-Arm Cable Row
exercises.cue: Pull the elbow behind you without giving away posture.
exercises.prescription: 6 controlled reps per side. Each 30-sec side window is pacing only, never AMRAP. Keep the torso square so the pull supports arm-drag connection without twisting.
exercises.home: 6 controlled reps per side. Each 30-sec side window is pacing only, never AMRAP. Keep the torso square so the pull supports arm-drag connection without twisting.
exercises.away: Use a light backpack or supported dumbbell row for 6 controlled reps per side.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Cable Chop
exercises.cue: Turn the trunk without collapsing the base.
exercises.prescription: 6 controlled reps per side. Each 30-sec side window is pacing only, never AMRAP. Rotate through the upper trunk while the hips stay organized.
exercises.home: 6 controlled reps per side. Each 30-sec side window is pacing only, never AMRAP. Rotate through the upper trunk while the hips stay organized.
exercises.away: Perform 6 slow shadow chops per side without resistance.

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry
exercises.cue: Keep the ribs stacked and shoulders level.
exercises.prescription: Carry 30 sec per side with a manageable kettlebell or dumbbell. This is timed posture work, not counted reps. Use quiet steps and stop before leaning.
exercises.home: Carry 30 sec per side with a manageable kettlebell or dumbbell. This is timed posture work, not counted reps. Use quiet steps and stop before leaning.
exercises.away: Use a loaded backpack or another familiar one-sided carry.

deposits.label: C
deposits.title: ROUNDS · KEEP THE RECOVERY CONNECTED
deposits.effort: 2 min easy technical movement, then 45 sec full reset. These are practice rounds, not conditioning sprints.

exercises.name: Guard-Recovery Connection Round
exercises.prescription: Use the same safe solo sequence at an easy pace: recover base, establish sticky feet, enter butterfly half, find the arm-drag angle, settle, reset. No hard submission finishing. Demo unavailable.
exercises.home: Use the same safe solo sequence at an easy pace: recover base, establish sticky feet, enter butterfly half, find the arm-drag angle, settle, reset. No hard submission finishing. Demo unavailable.
exercises.away: Shadow the same guard-recovery sequence continuously on a mat.
exercises.cue: Do not reach for the drag until your base and feet are connected.

levels.floor: 10:00 · 2 min moving prep + 6 min uninterrupted timed guard-recovery flow + 2 min support: 1×6/side light cable row with setup/reset
levels.standard: 35:05 · includes setup, side switches and rest

weekSummary: Moving prep → continuous guard-recovery skill → support strength → repeat the same skill in easy rounds
